([[Thompson, Connecticut]]) | college = * [[Richmond Spiders men's basketball|Richmond]] (2019–2023) * [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] (2023–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | career_end = | years1 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]]–[[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team1 = [[Memphis Hustle]] | years2 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team2 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | highlights = * 2× Second-team All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] (2022, 2023) * Atlantic 10 Most Improved Player (2021) }} '''Tyler Quinton Burton''' (born February 11, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] player, who most recently played for the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Richmond Spiders men's basketball|Richmond Spiders]] and the [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova Wildcats]]. ==High school career== Burton played five years of varsity basketball for [[Marianapolis Preparatory School]] in [[Thompson, Connecticut]], under head coach Andrew Vitale. He experienced a growth spurt as a sophomore and opted to [[Reclassification (education)|reclassify]], repeating his freshman year despite sufficient academic achievement.{{cite web |last1=O'Connor |first1=John |title=Freshman Tyler Burton has potential to be 'an all-time great player' at Richmond, believes his coach |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/plus/freshman-tyler-burton-has-potential-to-be-an-all-time-great-player-at-richmond-believes/article_61121468-96e0-5979-90cd-6c713a2b9f27.html |website=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]] |access-date=January 17, 2022 |date=December 26, 2019}} He was named [[New England Preparatory School Athletic Council]] Class B Player of the Year in his junior and senior seasons.{{cite web |title=Tyler Burton – Men's Basketball |url=https://richmondspiders.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/tyler-burton/4805 |publisher=University of Richmond Athletics |access-date=January 17, 2022}} Burton committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Richmond Spiders men's basketball|Richmond]] after developing a close connection with assistant coach Marcus Jenkins, choosing the Spiders over offers from [[St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball|St. Bonaventure]], [[Rhode Island Rams men's basketball|Rhode Island]], and [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena]]. ==College career== As a freshman at Richmond, Burton averaged 4.6 points and 3.9 rebounds per game. He entered the starting lineup as a sophomore due to a season-ending injury to Nick Sherod prior to the season.{{cite web |last1=O'Connor |first1=John |title=Spiders' depth has chance to shine early in season |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/richmond/spiders-depth-has-chance-to-shine-early-in-season/article_dbf97cc2-ffac-5828-a15c-b55bdb10c68e.html |website=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]] |access-date=January 17, 2022 |date=November 23, 2020}} Burton averaged 12 points and 7.6 rebounds per game, and was named [[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] Most Improved Player.{{cite web |last1=O'Connor |first1=John |title=Nick Sherod, Tyler Burton enter season as pivotal players for veteran Spiders |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/richmond/nick-sherod-tyler-burton-enter-season-as-pivotal-players-for-veteran-spiders/article_31ec6b50-d15a-54a8-ab6c-3a09c5736f46.html |website=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]] |access-date=January 17, 2022 |date=November 7, 2021}} He assumed an expanded role in his junior season with the departure of [[Blake Francis]].{{cite web |last1=O'Connor |first1=John |title='First-team all-Iowa' Tyler Burton was asked to rise by Spiders, and he has |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/richmond/first-team-all-iowa-tyler-burton-was-asked-to-rise-by-spiders-and-he-has/article_5a19549c-d6cd-5d71-9957-89f072bafebd.html |website=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]] |access-date=January 17, 2022 |date=December 6, 2021}} On November 20, 2021, Burton recorded 30 points and nine rebounds in a 73–70 loss to [[Drake Bulldogs men's basketball|Drake]].{{cite web |title=Burton Nets 30 in Loss to Drake |url=https://richmondspiders.com/news/2021/11/20/mens-basketball-burton-nets-30-in-loss-to-drake.aspx |publisher=University of Richmond Athletics |access-date=January 17, 2022 |date=November 20, 2021}} On February 4, 2022, he scored a career-high 36 points in a 71–61 victory over [[St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball|St. Bonaventure]].{{cite web |title=Burton explodes for 36 as Spiders beat Bonnies |url=https://richmondspiders.com/news/2022/2/4/mens-basketball-burton-explodes-for-36-as-spiders-beat-st-bonaventure.aspx |publisher=University of Richmond Athletics |access-date=February 6, 2022 |date=February 4, 2022}} Burton was named to the Second Team All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]].{{cite press release|url=https://atlantic10.com/news/2022/3/8/mens-basketball-brajkovic-named-atlantic-10-player-of-the-year-mckillop-osunniyi-earn-top-honors.aspx|title=Brajkovic Named Atlantic 10 Player of the Year, McKillop, Osunniyi Earn Top Honors|publisher=[[Atlantic 10 Conference]] |date=March 8, 2022 |accessdate=March 8, 2022}} As a junior, he averaged 16.1 points and 7.7 rebounds per game. On April 6, 2022, Burton declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility,{{cite web |title=Tyler Burton declares for NBA Draft, will maintain college eligibility |url=https://richmondspiders.com/news/2022/4/6/mens-basketball-tyler-burton-declares-for-nba-draft-will-maintain-college-eligibility.aspx |publisher=University of Richmond Athletics |access-date=April 21, 2022 |date=April 6, 2022}} but later withdrew. On May 31, 2023, he removed his name from the [[2023 NBA draft]] and transferred as a graduate to Villanova.{{cite web |title=Burton Joins the Wildcats as a Transfer |url=https://villanova.com/news/2023/6/12/mens-basketball-burton-joins-the-wildcats-as-a-transfer.aspx |website=[[Villanova Wildcats]] |access-date=February 21, 2024 |date=June 12, 2023}} ==Professional career== On March 12, 2026, Burton signed a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies Sign Tyler Burton to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-tyler-burton-to-10-day-contract|access-date=March 13, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}} On March 20, Burton recorded a career-high 23 points and five rebounds in a 112–117 loss to the [[2025–26 Boston Celtics season|Boston Celtics]].{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies' Tyler Burton: Explodes for 23 points|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-tyler-burton-explodes-for-23-points/|access-date=April 18, 2026|website=cbssports.com|language=en}} On March 23, he re-signed with the Grizzlies on a second 10-day contract.{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies' Tyler Burton: Gets another 10-day deal|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-tyler-burton-gets-another-10-day-deal/|access-date=April 18, 2026|website=cbssports.com|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA
